notes.title: Team 'crazy moves', or team 'let's play it safe'?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39067082/1c95bb8244314d6f76dad03cd314bf79b0e2626a.gif[/img]
[h2]Do you love the craziest moves or do you prefer more of a laid-back style to avoid looking a bit show offish? For each off the button combinations, you can choose a trick that suits you best.
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39067082/9f2491ed515f49fe0f5a284ab2d3c6dfe61940ed.gif[/img]

[h3]And remember - the more complicated the trick, the more spectacular the look you can achieve with customisation! Of course, that applies to the combos you get for it as well. Try it for yourself in Urban Trial Tricky!
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39067082/32e4cf21c78ff6a3deed704409d61cf293d1d7c8.gif[/img]

[h3]So much selection? Doesn't it seem a bit fishy? Yeah, it does. It's not like a selection this wide comes for free. Work hard, perform tricks, complete challenges. Only then you will have the funds necessary to access all of the options, but believe us when we say that it's totally worth it![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39067082/e310734c8df1ec90f069294d9411efc332f07e57.gif[/img]

[h3]Be careful not to kick the bucket and make this trick become quite literal with its name. All of the tricks require strategy and focus if you wanna earn these ?[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1380060/Urban_Trial_Tricky_Deluxe_Edition/

[h2]🏍️ KEY FEATURES 🏍️[/h2]

[list][*]Exciting light-hearted casual gameplay
[*]Crazy mix of tricks, platforming, and racing
[*]Killer tricks to combine in countless combos
[*]Super-smooth experience
[*]3 single-player modes
[*]Over 30 levels + side challenges
[*]Savage customization options
[*]Leaderboards to rule
[*]Infinite gameplay
[*]More freedom, more fun. Riding in both directions.[/list]

[h2][b]DEFY GRAVITY WITH CRAZY TRICKS![/b][/h2]
[b]BECOME A CRAZY TRICKSTER![/b]
Grab your seat and pull off the most savage tricks and combos on your motorbike. Ride freely, spin around in the air, go back and forth and let yourself be carried away by the fun, fast-paced gameplay, colorful visuals, and smooth controls.

Learn new freestyle, breakdance and FMX moves to fit your own style. Unlock crazy costumes and customize your motorbike at will.

[b]PUSH YOURSELF AND OTHERS TO GREATNESS![/b]
Complete challenges and master countless outstanding maneuvers and tricks to rule the leaderboards.
